_doc: The four pre-made heroes. The player may pick one as their own character; the others can be recruited (see the *_town / *_camp entries in entities.json). abilities are base scores before racial modifiers (15-point buy). Numbers are checked by tests/test_rules.gd.

kaelen.name: Kaelen Ashford
kaelen.portrait: A handsome human man in his late twenties with a strong jaw, short dark brown hair, light stubble and calm grey eyes, wearing a steel breastplate over a blue-grey gambeson, the rim of a round shield visible on his back. A steady, dependable caravan guard.
kaelen.bio: A caravan guard with no caravans left to guard. Steady, practical, and happiest with a shield on his arm and something to stand in front of.

pip.name: Pip Underbough
pip.portrait: A halfling woman in her twenties with a mischievous grin, tousled honey-brown curls, bright hazel eyes and freckles, wearing a dark green leather jerkin and a hooded cloak. A charming rogue who is clearly up to something.
pip.bio: Locks, ledgers and ladders a speciality. Pip insists she has never stolen anything that was not already lost.

brunhild.name: Brunhild Stonehymn
brunhild.portrait: A dwarven woman, broad and strong, with a kind but stern face and thick copper-red braids held by bronze clasps, wearing cream and gold vestments over scale armour, a holy symbol at her collar. A no-nonsense priestess.
brunhild.bio: Keeper of Hollowmere's shrine. She buried half the people now walking about the Barrow, and takes it personally.
brunhild.greeting: Stonefather keep you. What is it?

thessaly.name: Thessaly Wren
thessaly.portrait: A beautiful elven woman with long flowing silver-white hair, elegant pointed ears, violet eyes and a thoughtful, slightly aloof expression, wearing an elegant deep blue robe-dress with gold trim and holding a worn spellbook. A graceful scholar-wizard.
thessaly.bio: A scholar of old wards who came to study the Barrow from a sensible distance. The distance keeps shrinking.
